item.title: Photo | American robins branch out in Santa Cruz
item.description: American robins roost on a tree on Laurel Street in Santa Cruz on a recent afternoon. These birds are seen throughout North America -- from breeding grounds above the Arctic Circle in Alaska and Canada to wintering on Costa Esmeralda in Mexico along the Gulf Coast.
